card-term.purpose: The word being studied in Learn, 30px/700; flashcard face 28px/700.

control.purpose: Buttons, rows, inputs, options, 15 to 16px at 600 to 700.

caption.purpose: Metadata, legends, counts, 13 to 14px tabular numerals.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Cards, list rows, toast, switch knob, active segment. Dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.32).

shadows.name: sheet-shadow
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheet and Learn feedback panel. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,.6).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Movement: slides, card flip (420ms), pager and progress changes.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes; press transforms .1s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action per view, full width at the bottom on phones.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 12px); background: var(--accent, #4255FF); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; transition: background-color .15s ease-out, transform .1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-press, #3443E6); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink, #3446F0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 12px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #282E3E); border: 2px solid var(--line, #D9DDE8); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; transition: border-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2, #586380); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink, #3446F0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Set Card
components.description: White 16px card with ambient shadow; set rows and the resume card use it.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-card, 16px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #282E3E); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgba(40,46,62,.06), 0 6px 18px rgba(40,46,62,.08)); } .ds-card b { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card span { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #586380); }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill, 999px); background: var(--accent-soft, #E7EAFF); color: var(--accent-ink, #3446F0); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: 2px bordered box on Home; focus border turns Action Blue.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #D9DDE8); border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 12px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #282E3E); font-size: 16px; } .ds-search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #4255FF); }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: Learn multiple-choice option; correct and wrong states use fill border plus soft tint.
components.css: .ds-option { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #D9DDE8); border-radius: var(--r-ctl, 12px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #282E3E); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; transition: border-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2, #586380); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink, #3446F0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Bottom bar Home / add / Settings; active tab Link Ink Blue, add is a blue circle.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px 10px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #D9DDE8); } .ds-tab { justify-self: center; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #586380); text-decoration: none; } .ds-active { color: var(--accent-ink, #3446F0); } .ds-plus { justify-self: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--accent, #4255FF); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-plus:hover { background: var(--accent-press, #3443E6); }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: StageBar: mastered (green) and learning (orange) segments on a track.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; height: 10px; border-radius: var(--r-pill, 999px); background: var(--surface-2, #EDEFF4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; } .ds-m { background: var(--good-fill, #18AE79); } .ds-l { background: var(--learning-fill, #FF983A); }

narrative.overview:
Quizly is Quizlet's study loop played straight: the app steps aside and leaves the word, its sound and the next step. The ground is a cool grey-blue (light) or deep navy (dark), cards are white or lifted navy with 16px corners, a single blue carries every action, and green, orange and red appear only to report learning state. Nothing asks the owner to relearn a layout; familiarity is the feature.

Density is comfortable and thumb-first: one column at most 560px wide, 48px minimum controls, bottom-anchored primary actions. Depth is soft and ambient, motion is short and functional, and type is one family at confident weights.
keyCharacteristics: One blue for actions; green, orange and red only for learning state.
Rounded-but-not-bubbly: 12px controls, 16px cards, 20px sheets and flashcards.
Figtree only, heavy weights (600 to 800) for hierarchy, sentence case.
Light and dark themes with identical roles; dark is a navy, not black.
Lucide icons, stroke style, paired with text or an accessible name.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Components never carry a literal colour; every colour is a variable from src/styles/tokens.css. The one literal fallback is the #F6F7FB meta theme-color default in ThemeSync.

rules.name: The State-Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, orange and red mean learning state or error and nothing else. Decoration uses blue or neutrals.

rules.name: The Text-Variant Rule
rules.body: Coloured text uses the text variants (good, bad, learning, accent-ink); the -fill variants are for bars, borders and dots, never for small text.

rules.name: The Two-Declaration Rule
rules.body: The dark set exists twice in tokens.css (prefers-color-scheme rule and :root[data-theme="dark"]). Change both together.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by weight (400, 600, 700, 800) in a tight 12 to 17px band; sizes above 17px are reserved for the term being studied and screen headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Counts, progress and timers use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Soft-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are blurred and low-contrast; hard offset shadows do not exist in this system.

dos: Do take every colour from a token in src/styles/tokens.css and set both theme blocks together.
Do use Action Blue for the single primary action per view and keep it at the bottom within thumb reach.
Do use -fill colours for bars and borders and text variants for coloured text.
Do keep controls at 12px radius, cards at 16px, sheets and the flashcard at 20px.
Do show absent card-back parts as nothing, never as empty placeholders.
Do pair every icon (Lucide) with a visible label or an accessible name.
donts: Don't use green, orange or red for decoration; they mean learning state or error.
Don't use hard offset shadows or heavy borders on cards; depth is the soft card shadow.
Don't introduce a second accent colour or a new font family.
Don't reinvent layouts the owner already knows from Quizlet (tab bar, resume card, flip card, option list).
Don't rely on hover for any function; hover styling is gated to hover-capable pointers.
